annotations.text:
Animated rebuild of docs/Student Journey.jpg.

The line draws itself over ~3.4s, a bright dash runs just ahead of it, and each stage lights up as the line reaches it. Loops on an 11s cycle so you can watch it without clicking.

Honours prefers-reduced-motion: goes straight to the finished frame.

Three directions, not three shades of one.

A - Institutional trust: reads like an accredited education body. Serif, navy, structured. Leads with the intake calendar.
Tradeoff: safe; looks like a consultancy, not a product.

B - Product first: the tracker IS the pitch. Shows the real checklist UI in the hero.
Tradeoff: sells the tool, less the expertise.

C - Germany specialist: one destination, stated as authority. Dark, editorial, opinionated.
Tradeoff: closes the door on other countries later.

Every number I could not verify is a [BRACKETED] placeholder - no invented placement counts, no fake testimonials.
